verdict.rationale: TruffleHog OSS is open-source, installable via brew/Docker/binary, and docs explicitly offer a self-hosted deployment option ('Choose hosted... or self-hosted (running in your environment)'), confirming self-hosting the core scanner is a first-class supported path. missing for 10: independent hands-on report of a full self-hosted enterprise deployment, and more detail on infrastructure requirements/scaling for self-hosting beyond the CLI.
